def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    marker=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in p); c0=min(c for r,c in p)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in p}
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-max(r for r,c in shape)):
      for c in range(w-max(c for r,c in shape)):
        if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 or g[r+dr][c+dc]==marker for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out
